Joint Statement by Secretary of Health and Human Services Robert F. Kennedy and Secretary of State Marco Rubio on Termination of WHO Membership

Joint Statement by Secretary of Health and Human Services Robert F. Kennedy and Secretary of State Marco Rubio on Termination of WHO Membership

Press Statement

Marco Rubio, Secretary of State

Robert F. Kennedy, Secretary of Health and Human Services

January 22, 2026

Today the United States completes its withdrawal from the World Health Organization.

We will continue to work with partners who share our commitment to accountability.
